confidence_notes: Medium overall. Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors are aggregated from several Pisa cost-of-living and guide results (Numbeo, Expatistan, World-prices, Hikersbay, Visit Pisa). They disagree, are mostly dated May to September 2026 with some older or undated, and are not a July 2026 survey. The two-person meal is set in the upper part of their range to reflect July demand. Cocktail is weaker: no standard-cocktail price was found, so it rests on Pisa spritz prices and about 1.7 times the draught-beer anchor. Wine_glass is also weaker: no reliable Pisa per-glass price was found, so it rests on bottle prices, national house-wine glass reports and about 1.1 times the beer anchor. EUR amounts use an assumed rate of 1.12 USD per EUR that search did not verify, adding a few percent of uncertainty to the food and drink anchors. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and July peak-season context. No booking pages or live listings were inspected, so they are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Tuscany and central Italian tourist-city pricing. Food and drink use Pisa-specific figures, sanity-checked against Numbeo comparison pages for Rome and Pistoia. Accommodation is a holistic estimate positioned against mid-sized Italian tourist cities with similar July demand.
